item.text: {"issues":[{"coherent":"no","description":"Reviews vary between inability to download, missing download options, and needing to add songs to a playlist before downloading; several examples are unrelated to offline downloads.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["38308969-b377-40e2-9468-17719aba450b","eab514f9-2a0b-41cc-a3d3-ec5ef45b6bb2","5dcdf620-d1b2-4727-b59d-07688027c6fb"],"issue_id":"I_DOWNLOADS_01","issue_name":"Downloading songs and playlists"},{"coherent":"yes","description":"Downloaded music, particularly liked songs, fails to load or play reliably in offline mode, sometimes requiring workarounds or reconnecting to the internet.","heterogeneous_review_ids":[],"issue_id":"I_DOWNLOADS_02","issue_name":"Downloaded songs fail offline"},{"coherent":"no","description":"Examples cover repeated or unreliable downloads and offline playback, alongside account-sharing limits, app slowness, and other unrelated playback problems.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["cabe34ed-3cea-486d-87e7-fff38e310b68","ea626d17-40da-443b-8c41-f3e4873b6a5e","c8bd80d9-9f63-434c-a6dc-eea0c4fb10c4","f7cf8c32-1453-48ab-899d-48293174a67f","3c2ea9d7-5bf9-4f9c-b557-b24ebc995ebe"],"issue_id":"I_DOWNLOADS_03","issue_name":"Downloads repeatedly fail or restart"},{"coherent":"yes","description":"Reviews report generally being unable to download songs or other content, without a more specific recurring cause.","heterogeneous_review_ids":[],"issue_id":"I_DOWNLOADS_04","issue_name":"Unable to download"},{"coherent":"yes","description":"Spotify switches downloads from the selected SD card to internal phone storage, often leading to duplicate downloads and depleted device space.","heterogeneous_review_ids":[],"issue_id":"I_DOWNLOADS_05","issue_name":"SD card storage resets"}]}
